scope_transfers.authority: adversarial exact-head review, PM directive 2026-07-30 (close every P0/P1)
scope_transfers.reason: Both are pull_request-triggered, check out the PR head, and run scripts from that checkout with a production service-role key / production superuser Postgres URL. In both cases the scripts they execute are themselves inside the workflow's trigger path filter, so a PR that edits one runs its own version against production. The path filter decides whether the job runs; the checkout decides what runs. Closed with scripts/ci/assert-unmodified-vs-base.ts rather than by removing the credential, because these two legitimately need to READ production.
